standard_prerequisites.name: The boundary maps of the long exact sequence of a short exact sequence of cochain complexes
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Homology, Lemma labelled homology-lemma-long-exact-sequence-cochain (canonical Stacks tag 0117); invoked at proof line 960
standard_prerequisites.use: Supplies the existence of the connecting maps and of the long exact sequence; the functoriality of the construction is the counted step.

core_obligations: Get exactness of the Cech complex functor: by the preceding lemma, a short exact sequence 0 -> F_1 -> F_2 -> F_3 -> 0 of abelian presheaves is turned into a short exact sequence of complexes of Z-modules, so the machinery of the long exact sequence becomes available (proof lines 954-959).

Produce the boundary maps: apply the long exact sequence lemma for cochain complexes to obtain the connecting homomorphisms delta from Cech cohomology of F_3 in degree n to Cech cohomology of F_1 in degree n+1, together with the corresponding long exact sequence (proof lines 960-965).

Complete the delta-functor: the compatibility of these maps with maps between short exact sequences of presheaves is what makes the family of functors a delta-functor, and the author leaves that verification to the reader (proof lines 965-967).
proof_roadmap: Use exactness of the Cech complex functor to turn a short exact sequence of presheaves into a short exact sequence of complexes (proof lines 954-959).
Apply the standard long exact sequence construction for cochain complexes to define the connecting maps (proof lines 960-965).
Leave the compatibility check with maps of short exact sequences to the reader, which is the last axiom of a delta-functor (proof lines 965-967).
difficulty_reason: The lemma equips the Cech cohomology functors of a fixed family on the category of abelian presheaves with the structure of a cohomological delta-functor (statement lines 947-950). The proof is short, and its logic is that of a reduction: the preceding exactness statement turns a short exact sequence of presheaves into a short exact sequence of complexes of Z-modules, which is precisely the input needed to invoke the standard construction of connecting maps and the long exact sequence (proof lines 954-965). The only part not written out is the compatibility of these maps with maps between short exact sequences, which the author explicitly omits and which is reproduced as written. The claim is H2: one cited construction applied to a cited exactness result.
